# GNK ASG — Safe Pre-publication Enhancements

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

List additional improvements that can be prepared before publication without changing the existing homepage design, visible layout or current portal functionality.

## Safe enhancements before publication

### 1. Metadata-only preparation

Prepare title, description, preview image data and canonical URL for the first article before it is linked publicly.

Impact on homepage: none.

### 2. Hidden preview route

Prepare the first article as an unlinked preview route. Do not add it to homepage, navigation or public cards until approved.

Impact on homepage: none.

### 3. Image preview package

Prepare image variants in advance:

- wide preview image
- square post image
- video thumbnail draft
- mobile crop note

Impact on homepage: none.

### 4. Internal link map

Prepare a link map for the article:

- company context
- group framework context
- document context
- insight archive context
- contact context

Impact on homepage: none.

### 5. Share text drafts

Prepare short and professional post drafts, but keep them outside public pages until release.

Impact on homepage: none.

### 6. Preview QA checklist

Before publication, verify:

- article page opens
- image loads
- canonical is correct
- internal links work
- mobile view is readable
- no placeholder text remains

Impact on homepage: none.

### 7. Dashboard-only status

Record status internally as:

- draft prepared
- needs review
- ready for release
- released

Do not show this status publicly until the public module is live.

Impact on homepage: none.

### 8. Sitemap delayed inclusion

Prepare sitemap entry, but include it only after publication.

Impact on homepage: none.

### 9. Home restraint rule

Do not change hero, first screen, menu or main cards for the first publication.

After publication, the homepage may receive only one discreet latest-insight card if approved.

Impact on homepage: protected.

### 10. Rollback note

Keep a rollback note for the first release: if link, image or mobile view fails, remove the public link and return the item to preparation.

Impact on homepage: safer activation.

## Recommended next step

Prepare the first full article package as draft-only:

- article text
- image package
- metadata
- internal links
- share drafts
- mobile notes

Then review it on desktop and mobile before any public link is added.
